blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
Now let's put the same idea to work on something you will actually use.
A sticky header. The kind that follows the user as they scroll, appearing at just the right moment.

items: Check how far the page has moved
Add or remove a class based on a threshold

blocks.content:
1<!DOCTYPE html>
2<html lang="en">
3<head>
4  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
5  <title>Sticky header</title>
6  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css" />
7</head>
8<body>
9
10  <header class="site-header">
11    Header. Scroll down to stick.
12  </header>
13
14  <main class="content">
15    Scroll to see the header stick.
16  </main>
17
18  <script src="script.js"></script>
19</body>
20</html>
Click Run Code. Now scroll down a bit.
Once you pass 50 pixels, the header sticks.
Same event. Same threshold. Same toggle. Just applied to something real this time.
Next, you'll answer a quick quiz to lock in the idea.
